{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending), then drop duplicates
data = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
data = data.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Step 2: Compute response rate per site on the full deduplicated dataset
# Do NOT filter out biomarker_baseline == -999 because the contract specifies 'all patients who completed the trial'
response_rate_by_site = data.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Print to confirm
response_rate_by_site"}
